name: Aizawa Misaki
source:
A 38-year-old housewife. She is the PTA president of Ijikuri private school.

She is intelligent, fresh, humble, holds high ideals and a strong sense of responsibility.

Her husband was disabled in an accident five years ago, and she harbors intense frustration.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=717175]Getchu[/url]]
